actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (strong RNA pathway dysregulation plus CDKN2A/9p-9q loss enrichment), cross-modal membership supported by a majority of modalities with positive fused boundaries to all neighbors, and no technical factor explaining its molecular signal beyond a modest scanner-model caveat. Retain for downstream validation.

C0002 shows the most coherent cross-modal membership among the sets, with coherent RNA and CNV identity signal (distinctive chr14q/8p and chr3p loss pattern), positive fused boundaries to all neighbors, and no significant technical association. Retain for downstream validation.

C0003 has affirmative WXS identity evidence (near-absent PBRM1 and markedly reduced VHL mutation) coherent with lower-in-set loss trends at these loci, positive fused boundaries to all neighbors, and no significant technical association. Cross-modal coherence is WXS-driven, but this is a limitation rather than a structural incompatibility. Retain for downstream validation.

C0004 has affirmative WXS identity evidence (BAP1 mutation enrichment) with a coherent WNT-down RNA signal, the most stable internal structure among the sets, positive fused boundaries to all neighbors, and no significant technical association. Retain for downstream validation.
